milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The furnace is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 4) inside the oak shelter, ~6.4 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk toward the oak building (not trigger from spawn). facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking at the furnace.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw rabbit in a furnace produces cooked_rabbit which ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 cooked_rabbit, so having ≥1 confirms successful smelting. This is the preferred rule type for craft/cook tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The campfire is at spawn-relative (-5, 0, -5) inside the spruce shelter, ~7.8 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk toward the spruce building (not trigger from spawn). facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking at the campfire.
